events.title: FactSet 10位分析師再上修富世達2026 EPS中位數至62.42元，公開來源報導目標價2650元

observed_facts.summary: 鉅亨網引用FactSet最新調查，10位分析師對富世達2026 EPS預估中位數由61.85元再上修至62.42元；最高67.54元、最低58.65元，公開來源同時報導預估目標價2650元。

interpretation.summary: 這是前一輪FactSet consensus的進一步上修，可作V2.1 analyst reference與model-forward sanity check；在PIT analyst corpus及回測通過前不得直接影響production Fair Value。

events.evidence_summary: Public secondary source quoting FactSet consensus. The same publisher's prior 2026-09-09 observation reported a 61.85 median, supporting that this is a material subsequent revision; it remains discovery/reference evidence until deterministic materialization.
